note: Packaged MCP server entries for the Antigravity native lane (Plan 032 Phase 8, ADR 0032). One entry per server name the registry agents declare in `mcpServers:`; the launch command is the one the existing server definitions use (src/core/prerequisites.ts getMcpDefinition, pinned by test). Each `entry` is merged as-is into .agents/mcp_config.json under its name. No entry carries `env`, `headers` or `oauth`: a credential is never written. A server that needs one is shipped with `disabled: true` and names the variable in `requiresEnv`; the user sets it in the environment agy starts from and runs `agy mcp enable <name>`. Whether agy passes its own environment on to a stdio server, and whether a `${VAR}` placeholder in `env` is expanded, are unverified, which is why no placeholder is written.
